newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel mutual fund assets drop again in August.
newsitem.headline: Israel mutual fund assets drop again in August.

text.p: Assets of Israel's mutual funds fell 1.7 percent to 12.97 billion shekels at the end of August from 13.19 billion shekels at the end of July, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report on Thursday.
The fall was mainly caused by continuing withdrawals from the funds, despite a better-performing stock market which brough net average returns of 0.7 percent to funds during the month, Meitav said.
However the pace of redemptions was slowing, with withdrawals falling to 335 million shekels in August from 571 million shekels in July.
Most of the redemptions were in funds specialising in shares and in bonds, the report said.
